svg.title: Ansh's tech stack
svg.desc: Tech icons orbiting on three tilted elliptical paths: Python, JavaScript, Java, C++, C, OpenAI; React, Node.js, Express, Flask, Tailwind, HTML5, CSS; MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Docker, AWS, Git, GitHub, Postman. Grouped stack: Languages: JavaScript, C, C++, Java, Python, SQL; Ai / Ml: Supervised/Unsupervised Learning, Neural Networks, Model Training, Data Preprocessing, OpenAI API, NLP; Frontend: React, HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS; Backend & Apis: Node.js, Express.js, Flask, REST APIs, WebSockets; Databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB; Cloud & Tools: Docker, Git, GitHub, AWS, Render, Vercel, Linux, Postman.
